summary: preinstall script exfiltrates full process.env to hardcoded ngrok tunnel
details: The package's preinstall lifecycle hook runs an inline node script that serializes the installer's entire environment via JSON.stringify(process.env) and POSTs the result to the hardcoded host crabbing-thong-overhung.ngrok-free.dev at path /init_check. This fires automatically on npm install, before any user code runs, and transmits every environment variable of the installing host (including CI secrets, cloud credentials, NPM/GitHub tokens, and any other tokens present in the shell) to an attacker-controlled ngrok tunnel. The destination is a mutable tunneling endpoint unrelated to any legitimate publisher infrastructure, and the collected payload is bulk-env enumeration rather than any narrow named configuration key.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
